data.overview: The fetched brand-owned sources present two distinct entities: "Niche Beauty," a European multi-brand online retailer (niche-beauty.com), and "Niche Beauty Lab," a Spain-based skincare producer (nichebeautylab.com). Niche Beauty Lab makes self-published claims that its formulas are vegan and cruelty-free, that ~90% of raw materials are locally sourced in Spain, and that it aims to eliminate plastic packaging. No independent brand-specific assessments, third-party certifications, or legal matters were found in the fetched sources for either entity.

claims.claim: Niche Beauty Lab sources most raw materials locally and minimizes plastic in its packaging, aiming for zero plastic consumption.
claims.quote: Today, 90% of the raw materials we use to manufacture our products are locally sourced and only 10% of our packaging is made of plastic.

claims.claim: Niche Beauty Lab does not test on animals or work with suppliers who do.
claims.quote: all of our formulas are vegan and animal cruelty free. We do not test on animals or work with suppliers who do.

claims.claim: Niche Beauty Lab states that all of its formulas are vegan.
claims.quote: At Niche Beauty Lab all of our formulas are vegan and animal cruelty free.
